chunks: Ahmad, from ʿAbd al-ʿAẓīm, from Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl, from Abū Ḥamzah, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Jibraeel descended with this verse like this: “But most of the people refused concerning the wilayah of ʿAlī, except in denial.”
He عليه السلام said: “And Jibraeel عليه السلام descended with this verse like this:”

“And say: The truth is from your Lord regarding the wilayah of ʿAlī; so whoever wills, let him believe, and whoever wills, let him disbelieve. Indeed, We have prepared for those who wrong the family of Muḥammad a Fire.”

key_terms.آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ: the family of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الظَّالِمِينَ: those who commit wrongdoing or oppression
key_terms.الْآيَةِ: the verse of the Quran being cited
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلُ: Jibraeel, the angel who brings revelation
key_terms.وَلَايَةِ: wilayah, divinely appointed authority and guardianship

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith interpret Quranic verses in relation to the wilayah of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a reported revelatory wording connected to Quranic verses and interprets them in relation to the wilayah of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام. It frames acceptance of this wilayah as a matter of faith and warns of punishment for those who wrong Āl Muḥammad.

en.hubeali: Ahmad, from Abdul Azeem, from Muhammad Bin Al Fuzayl, from Abu Hamza, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘Jibraeelas descended with this Verse like this - [17:89] but most of the people refused (to accept) the Wilayah of Ali, except for the denying’.

Heasws said: ‘And Jibraeelas descended with this Verse like this - [18:29] And say: The Truth is from your Lord, regarding the Wilayah of Aliasws, so let him who desires to, believe, and let him who desires to, disbelieve; We have Prepared for the unjust to the Progeny of Muhammad, a Fire’.
en.sarwar: 64. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il from Muhammad ibn al-Fudayl from abu al-Hassan (a.s.) about the words of Allah. “All the places for prostration (or parts of the body to be placed on the ground during) belong to God [72:18] The Imam (a.s.) said, “They are the executors of the will of The Holy Prophet (s.a) .”
